instruction: For every product in all three zones, determine the mean quarterly sales and record it in the Total column.

metadata.explanation: Task requires calculating the average of Q1-Q4 for each product and filling it in column F. Verified with Python: F3=(4142+4867+3072+2370)/4=3612.75, F4=(2122+2014+3167+3478)/4=2695.25, etc. All 9 product averages computed and verified. Custom getter reads cells F3-F19, custom metric compares with expected averages using 0.1 tolerance.
